notes:
Describes someone or something that acts freely without restraint or convention. Can be positive (free-spirited, creative) or mildly negative (reckless, undisciplined) depending on context. Most commonly appears in the four-character compound {自由|じゆう}{奔放|ほんぽう}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自由|じゆう}{奔放|ほんぽう}: free and uninhibited (the most common usage)
- {奔放|ほんぽう}な{性格|せいかく}: uninhibited personality
- {奔放|ほんぽう}な{生|い}き{方|かた}: unrestrained way of living
- {奔放|ほんぽう}な{振|ふ}る{舞|ま}い: uninhibited behavior

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {自由|じゆう}: free — more neutral and general; simply means free or unrestricted
- {奔放|ほんぽう}: adds a sense of wildness or abandon beyond mere freedom
- {型破|かたやぶ}り: unconventional — emphasizes breaking from established patterns or norms
